title: VTA PCS — Vote — payload
description: A voter's client hands its VTA a ballot; the VTA checks it against the election's manifest, makes the ticket's attestation over it, and returns the complete voting/ballot/cast document, signed by a did:key used for this cast alone, for the client to send.

contextId.description: The context the voter belongs to.

community.description: The community's DID. MUST equal the manifest's `community`.

parameters.description: The community's published voting parameters. Its `votingKey` MUST be the one the ticket was issued under.

manifest.description: The election's manifest, exactly as registered. The engine recomputes its digest and checks it against the one it recorded at voter/register.

ballot.description: The voter's ballot. The cast binds its RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization.

CastDocument.title: CastDocument
CastDocument.description: A complete, signed voting/ballot/cast/0.1 request document, ready to send to the ballot box. Its payload is validated by that specification's schema; the members fixed here are the ones this task guarantees.

id.description: A random (version 4) UUID URN, generated for this cast and derived from nothing else.

issuer.description: The did:key generated for this cast alone (VTI-VOT-003).

payload.description: The voting/ballot/cast/0.1 request payload — `community`, `electionId` and the Cast the engine built — and nothing else.

proof.description: The Data Integrity proof made with the cast's one-time key.

tag.description: The cast's tag (the election's nullifier for this ticket), as the cast carries it. The same for every cast this ticket makes in this election.
